description: This file defines data structures (TypedDict classes) for interacting with a Bedrock Knowledge Base, including request and response formats, content, location, and configuration options.

classes.name: BedrockKBLocation
classes.description: Location information for a retrieved document.

classes.name: BedrockKBRowValue
classes.description: Row value in a retrieved document.

classes.name: BedrockKBRetrievalResult
classes.description: Individual result from a knowledge base retrieval.

classes.name: BedrockKBResponse
classes.description: Response from a Bedrock Knowledge Base retrieval request.

classes.name: BedrockKBMetadataAttribute
classes.description: Metadata attribute configuration for implicit filtering.

classes.name: BedrockKBSelectiveModeConfiguration
classes.description: Configuration for selective mode in reranking.

classes.name: BedrockKBRerankingConfiguration
classes.description: Configuration for reranking in vector search.

classes.name: BedrockKBRequest
classes.description: Complete request structure for Bedrock Knowledge Base retrieval.
